videos.title: ESP32 Pinout Explained: Which Pins Are Safe to Use?
videos.description:
The ESP32 DevKit has 38 pins – but not all of them are safe. In this video we go through the entire pinout, group by group: power pins, flash pins you should never touch, strapping pins, serial pins, input-only pins, ADC1 vs ADC2, DAC, touch pins and the default I2C and SPI pins. At the end there's a cheat sheet you can screenshot.

videos.title: 3D Printing Started With a Toy Frog 🐸 #shorts #entrepreneur #tech
videos.description:
In 1988 Scott Crump made a toy frog for his daughter with a hot glue gun full of plastic and candle wax. That idea became FDM, the most common kind of 3D printing. When the key patent expired in 2009, prices fell from around $20,000 to under $1,000.

▶️ Full documentary on my channel: The History of 3D Printing
